component.name: xl-Screenshot
component.summary: Take a screenshot of the screen, a window, or a selection

description.p: xl-Screenshot is a screenshot tool for Linux Mint and the Cinnamon desktop, with a simple window that follows the system theme.

ul.li: Window: click a window to capture it with its titlebar
Selection: draw an area over a still picture of the desktop, and adjust it with handles

description.p: A delay gives you time to open a menu first (Esc cancels it). Captures can be copied, saved as PNG, JPEG, or WebP, or marked up in xl-Annotate. An optional tray icon starts a selection with one click.
The About window links to the project page.
